label: Lisa Gherardini
summary: Florentine woman, wife of Francesco del Giocondo. Named by Agostino Vespucci in October 1503 as the subject of a head by Leonardo.

claims.statement: Born in Florence on 15 June 1479 (one older source says Naples 1474, which is not supported).

sources.cite: Wikipedia, Lisa del Giocondo. Background only, not a ground. Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

claims.statement: Died in 1542 aged about 63; the date 15 July 1542 is given in some accounts but not confirmed in this round.

sources.cite: The Florentine, Mona Lisa and Sant'Orsola (2024). Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

claims.statement: Married Francesco del Giocondo on 5 March 1495.

value.text: Sitter of the Louvre Mona Lisa

claims.statement: That the Louvre panel is her portrait rests on Vasari (1550) and on the Vespucci note; Louvre curator Delieuvin has said certainty is not possible. Beatis (1517) describes a portrait of 'a certain Florentine lady' made for Giuliano de' Medici, a separate testimony read in several ways.
